content_sections.heading: TIFR Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the TIFR Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download TIFR Job 2026 Employment Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: TIFR Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 10 vacancies are available - 2 for Carpenter, 3 for Electrician, 1 for Fitter, 1 for Welder (G&E), 1 for Painter, 1 for Machinist and 1 for Turner.

content_sections.heading: TIFR Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: The maximum age limit for candidates is 28 years. Age relaxation rules will be applicable as per government norms. Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for TIFR Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for TIFR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in selection for the Tradesman Trainees - Trade Apprentices posts at TIFR is scheduled for 30 September 2026. Candidates are advised to report at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum qualification required for these apprenticeship roles?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required is an ITI i.e. National Trade Certificate (NTC) with an aggregate of 60% marks awarded by the National Council of Vocational Training (NCVT) in the respective trade.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Tradesman Trainees - Trade Apprentices positions?
faq.answer: The age limit for candidates applying for these positions is below 28 years. Specific age relaxation rules may apply as per government guidelines.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for Tradesman Trainees - Trade Apprentices at TIFR?
faq.answer: There are a total of 10 vacancies for Tradesman Trainees - Trade Apprentices posts at the Tata Institute of Fundamental Research (TIFR).

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this TIFR recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary or stipend offered for these apprenticeship roles?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will be engaged on a stipendiary basis. Specific details regarding the stipend amount are usually provided in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. Which trades are included in this TIFR apprenticeship program?
faq.answer: The trades included are Carpenter, Electrician, Fitter, Welder (G&E), Painter, Machinist, and Turner.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the TIFR located for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The TIFR is located in Mumbai, Maharashtra, with the pincode 400005.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates (ITI mark sheets and certificates), and one set of self-attested photocopies of these documents.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for this TIFR recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive. Candidates can attend the walk-in interview without paying any fee.
